items.name: hook_en
items.direction: Narrate this as a popular geography YouTube Shorts channel. The Narrator is a deep, warm, confident storyteller: brisk and curious, with natural emphasis and a short comic pause before each punchline; a little awe on the depth reveals. Chars voices funny cartoon characters (a pompous, touchy Lake Superior; a weary deadpan Belgium), short and punchy. This is the opening line of the Short: punchy and intriguing, with a little stress on 'more water' and 'all five'.
lines: This one lake holds more water than all five Great Lakes put together.
